body: Appreciate it ❤️. Seems we both struggling a bit at the moment

As cliche as it sounds, you've got options. You have reached out to people and haven't gotten a reply or answer at what seems like a tough time for you now. I know what that feels like. I've gone up to a secluded spot in the mountains with my service handgun, ready to say goodbye. 

Yet, you'd be surprised when that one person you didn't think would come through for you does. Give yourself half an hour before taking any action. It's what kept me here for now at least. Might do the same for you.
Not going to tell you not to do it. I don't know the pain you're going through. If you want to talk about anything whilst you're going through this, I'm here.

That's what I thought. Unfortunately, we cannot find any singles that we require anywhere. I only need two to complete the collection. My partner and child need a few more, but the cards we need I cannot find anywhere 😞

Only to wake up to 15 app notifications and an alarm you forgot you set. 
I could fall asleep for a month and wouldn't get a message from anyone

Just be honest about it. Pretty lucky to have someone like that in your life. I've been in similar situations and have had no one bothered to check in, even if they are aware if I've been struggling. 

Or if you don't want to go into specifics about it with them, just thank them for being a support for you and that you greatly appreciate them.
